<subject>Re: Ironbark Logistics Agreement</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our Pit 7B haulage permit and the legal opinion at closing on Wednesday. They were okay with that. If that's a problem, I can fax the guaranty and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funding...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30 April 2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Ironbark Logistics Agreement

Good morning.

In order to finish up Ironbark Logistics Agreement tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

GE parent guaranty  
LOC (so that full payment can be made to GE tomorrow)  
Opinion of counsel  

And once funds are received by GE, we need the receipt of funds letter.  

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Port Hedland gang to find out if the LV Co Gen contract is ready. Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.  

Thanks,  

Adam
</quoted>
